hazards: Import cycles. extensions/types.ts imports tool types (BashOperations, EditToolDetails, BashResult, ExecOptions, ExecResult) while every tool imports ToolDefinition from it. tools/*.ts and tools/renderers/*.ts also import each other. Go forbids package cycles, so put ToolDefinition, ToolRenderContext, ExtensionToolContext (a minimal interface), and the tool Details/Operations types in a leaf package, and keep tools and renderers in one Go package.

UTF-16 vs UTF-8. JS .length and .slice are UTF-16 code units: truncateLine (500 chars), the bash-executor rolling buffer (text.length), and fuzzy-match indices in edit-diff. Buffer.byteLength is UTF-8. Choose the unit explicitly for each call site. A UTF-16 cut can leave a lone surrogate, which Rust/Go strings cannot represent.

Number formatting. Number.toFixed rounds exact binary ties up (formatSize(1280) gives '1.3KB'), while Rust {:.1} and Go strconv round ties to even. JS Number toString appears in messages ('maximum is 2147483.647 seconds', the timed-out seconds). serde_json prints an integral f64 as 2.0 where JS prints 2 (wall_time_seconds). Write JS-compatible helpers.

JS String.trim strips U+FEFF and all ECMAScript WhiteSpace/LineTerminator characters. Rust str::trim and Go strings.TrimSpace do not strip U+FEFF. Affects frontmatter bodies and several message builders.

Regex dialect. changelog LEGACY_REPO_RE uses a lookahead (?=\/|$), unsupported by Rust regex and Go RE2. Rust \d is Unicode (use [0-9]). Replacement callbacks with groups need a hand-written loop in Go. Flags /gi and /i map to (?i). The ansi-regex lazy [\s\S]*? works in both.

String.prototype.replace in export-html replaces the first occurrence only and interprets $$, $&, $` and $' in replacement strings. Current assets contain none of these, so plain single replacement is equivalent, but add a guard test.

Unicode normalization and collation. NFKC in edit fuzzy matching, NFD for macOS filename variants, and ICU localeCompare for ls ordering all need libraries (unicode-normalization/feruca in Rust; x/text norm/collate in Go). A plain codepoint sort changes ls output.

Process management:
- Unix bash runs detached in its own process group and is killed with kill(-pid, SIGKILL). Rust process_group(0) + libc::killpg; Go Setpgid + syscall.Kill(-pid).
- Windows uses System32 taskkill /F /T.
- Legacy WSL bash.exe takes the command over stdin.
- Detached PIDs are tracked for shutdown.
- A signal exit is reported as 128+signo.
- Go cmd.Wait blocks while a grandchild holds the stdout pipe: use your own pipe readers or WaitDelay to implement the waitForChildProcess exit + 100ms idle-grace semantics (#5303).

Streaming decoding. TextDecoder({stream:true}) keeps partial UTF-8 sequences across chunks and emits U+FFFD for invalid bytes. exec.ts uses per-chunk Buffer.toString. fs.readFile 'utf-8' replaces invalid bytes. The ports must decode lossily the same way.

Timing constants to preserve: bash update throttle 100ms (with an initial empty update), exit stdio grace 100ms re-armed on each chunk, raw stdout retry every 10ms on EAGAIN/ENOBUFS, exec SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 5s, tools-manager network timeout 10s and download timeout 120s, fetchWithRetry overall and per-attempt timeouts, FS watch retry 5s. Model AbortSignal composition (AbortSignal.any/timeout) with CancellationToken (Rust) or context.Context (Go).

Module-load-time evaluation. config.ts reads package.json at import, and tools-manager computes TOOLS_DIR = getBinDir() at import. Tests set env before importing. Native ports should compute lazily with the same env inputs and allow test overrides.

Global mutable state: the file-mutation queue map (needs FIFO fairness; Go sync.Mutex is not FIFO), tracked detached PIDs, the stdout takeover sink, the raw-stdout write chain, and the embedded QuickJS wasm path. All need thread-safe globals.

Persisted and wire field names must stay exact:
- TruncationResult camelCase fields with truncatedBy null.
- EditToolDetails {diff, patch, firstChangedLine}.
- BashToolDetails {truncation, fullOutputPath}.
- Find/Grep/Ls details (resultLimitReached, matchLimitReached, linesTruncated, entryLimitReached).
- BashResult in bashExecution entries.
- bash structuredContent snake_case.
- Omit undefined fields, and beware Go omitempty dropping 0 and false (exitCode 0).
TypeBox schema JSON key order and the omission of required when no field is required are visible to providers and in HTML exports. Build schemas as ordered JSON.

Node error messages leak into tool output (`Cannot read directory: ${e.message}`, `Failed to run fd: ...`, `Failed to run ripgrep: ...`, ENOENT text). Native messages differ: map common errnos to Node-style text or relax the test assertions.

Platform naming. process.platform and process.arch strings (darwin/linux/win32, x64/arm64) appear in the user agent and in fd/rg asset selection. Map Rust/Go OS and arch names. On Windows the PATH env key is case-insensitive.

Path semantics. Node path.resolve is lexical; Rust std::path::absolute keeps '..'. fileURLToPath and pathToFileURL encoding rules, encodeURI and path.posix.normalize (changelog links) need hand-ports in Go and careful mapping in Rust.
Image pipeline output (encoded bytes, possibly the chosen quality step) will differ from photon. Assert dimensions and limits only. EXIF orientation must still be applied before resizing.
Syntax highlighting output will not match hljs exactly. Map native token scopes onto hljs scope names to keep theme mappings and tests meaningful, or embed hljs in quickjs-wasi for parity.
OSC 52 clipboard output and every stdout write must pass through the output-guard sink so JSON/RPC modes keep stdout clean.
The ZIP writer uses local time for DOS timestamps. The Rust time crate's local-offset lookup is unreliable in multithreaded processes; use chrono::Local.

Self-update and asset location logic assumes npm/pnpm/yarn/bun installs or a Bun binary. A native binary needs embedded assets, on-disk extraction of README/docs/examples for the model, and a standalone update path.
js_runtime_dependent: photon.ts loads photon-node WASM and patches fs.readFileSync for Bun binaries. Replace it with native image codecs (Rust image crate / Go image + x/image); no WASM is needed.
image-resize-worker.ts and image-resize.ts use worker_threads. Replace them with spawn_blocking/std::thread (Rust) or a goroutine (Go). The worker entry file goes away.

syntax-highlight.ts uses the highlight.js runtime plus dynamic import() to lazy-load all languages (loadAllHighlightLanguages). Replace with syntect+two-face (Rust) or chroma/v2 (Go), registered eagerly and mapped to hljs scope names. Optionally run hljs inside the embedded quickjs-wasi (wasmtime/wazero) for exact parity.

The export-html template.js, vendor/marked.min.js and vendor/highlight.min.js run in the viewer's browser, not in pi. Embed them verbatim (include_str!/go:embed); generating the HTML needs no JS runtime.

config.ts isBunBinary/isBunRuntime/isBundledNode detection (import.meta.url $bunfs/~BUN, process.versions.bun, the PI_BUNDLED_NODE define) and the src-vs-dist asset probing. Replace with compile-time constants and embedded assets, keep PI_PACKAGE_DIR as an override, and extract docs/README/examples to disk for the model.
getQuickJSWasmPath/setEmbeddedQuickJSWasmPath resolve quickjs-wasi/quickjs.wasm via createRequire. Use embedded wasm bytes loaded by wasmtime (Rust) or wazero (Go) for native codemode.
resolveCodemodeWorkerSpecifier/getCodemodeWorkerSpecifier select a Bun or Node worker entrypoint. Remove them; native codemode runs in-process on a thread or goroutine.

detectInstallMethod/getSelfUpdateCommand (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun global installs) and windows-self-update.ts (quarantining loaded .node addons found through process.report.getReport().sharedObjects). For a standalone native binary, report the standalone method with download instructions or rename the running exe. Keep the npm logic only if the binaries are also shipped through an npm wrapper package.
output-guard.ts monkey-patches process.stdout.write to divert to stderr. Replace it with a process-wide output sink that all stdout writers use, plus a raw protocol writer with EAGAIN retry.
pi-tui native clipboard .node addon (getNativeClipboard). Replace with arboard (Rust) or golang.design/x/clipboard (Go), keeping the command and OSC 52 fallbacks.

getPiUserAgent embeds the JS runtime token (node/<version> or bun/<version>). Replace it with a rust/<version> or go/<version> token while keeping the `pi/<version> (<platform>; <runtime>; <arch>)` shape and Node platform/arch names.

tool-renderer.ts pre-renders custom tools for HTML export by calling arbitrary extension ToolDefinition renderCall/renderResult closures. Under the native trait/interface extension API this only covers built-in and native extension tools (mcp, codemode, llama, tool-search); user TS extensions are not loaded, so their tool results fall back to template rendering.
cross-spawn (win32 .cmd/.bat shim execution) in child-process.ts. Replace it with native PATHEXT resolution plus explicit cmd.exe invocation with safe escaping.

units.title: Theme engine: Theme class, theme JSON loading/validation, system theme generation, terminal color controller, built-in themes
skipped_tests: packages/coding-agent/test/suite/regressions/2791-fswatch-error-crash.test.ts -- relies on process._getActiveHandles and emitting 'error' on a Node FSWatcher; replace with a native unit test asserting a watcher error closes the watcher without crashing
packages/coding-agent/test/test-theme-colors.ts -- dev script that prints swatches, not a test
units.notes:
Rust: modes::interactive::theme::{theme, theme_json, system_theme, theme_controller}. Go: package interactive/theme. Build this unit first; most of the coding-agent crate depends on it.

Global state:
- The TS `theme` export is a Proxy over globalThis[Symbol.for('@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent:theme')]; the legacy @mariozechner key exists only for duplicate JS module copies. Natively use one global: Rust ArcSwap<Theme> or RwLock<Arc<Theme>> behind fn theme() -> Arc<Theme>; Go atomic.Pointer[Theme].
- onThemeChange listeners are a Vec of boxed callbacks. Registered themes come from extensions or the resource loader.
- Terminal colors and color scheme are separate globals. setTerminalColors uses identity checks to invalidate the lazy color cache.

Byte parity:
- fg/bg use precomputed ANSI per mode (truecolor/256 via getTerminalColorMode).
- Token "" emits \x1b[39m / \x1b[49m.
- Dim fg: `${ansi}\x1b[2m${text}\x1b[22;39m`. Dim bg: `${ansi}${text}\x1b[49m`.
- bold/italic/underline/inverse/strikethrough go through chalk 6. Hand-port chalk's applyStyle: replace inner close codes with the open code and wrap \n / \r\n with close+open. Port its supports-color level detection (FORCE_COLOR, NO_COLOR, TTY, TERM=dumb, CI); level 0 returns plain text.
- Appearance detection uses average OKLab L of concrete colors, excluding palette indices 0-15.

Theme JSON:
- Fields: name (may not contain '/'), $schema, vars, colors (camelCase tokens), optional export {pageBg, cardBg, infoBg}.
- Literals: number 0-255, "", #hex, and /^ok(lch|hsl)\(/i strings. Var refs resolve recursively, with an exact error message for circular refs.
- Fallbacks: scrollbarTrack->muted, scrollbarThumb->text, thinkingMax->thinkingXhigh, searchMatchBg->selectedBg, searchMatchText->text.
- BACKGROUND_TOKENS: selectedBg, searchMatchBg, userMessageBg, customMessageBg, toolPendingBg, toolSuccessBg, toolErrorBg.
- Validation error text must match exactly: 'Missing required color tokens:' (sorted), then 'Other errors:' with lines `  - ${instancePath||'/'}: ${message}`, using typebox's message wording.
- TS validation is opt-in via setThemeJsonValidator to save ~17MB of imports. Natively, always validate; keep the setter as a no-op or remove it.

Loading:
- Built-ins are read from getThemesDir(). Embed dark/light with include_str!/go:embed, but getAvailableThemesWithPaths still reports a path (config.ts layout); decide on a virtual path.
- Ordering: 'system' first, then localeCompare; use ICU-like collation, not byte order.
- theme-schema.json is not loaded at runtime; ship it as a copied asset.

Watcher:
- fs.watch on the custom themes dir with a 100ms debounce and stale-timer guard. Reload the active custom theme; fall back to dark on deletion.
- On error, close the watcher (#2791). Use notify / fsnotify.

Terminal detection:
- parseAutoThemeSetting('light/dark') and resolveThemeSetting.
- detectColorFgBgTheme takes the last COLORFGBG field; 0-6 and 8 are dark.
- Priority: reported background, then scheme, then COLORFGBG, then dark.
- markTerminalColorsPending makes the system theme grayscale (saturation 0).

system-theme.ts:
- Float math must match JS: Math.round is half-up toward +inf, unlike Rust f64::round and Go math.Round (away from zero); use floor(x+0.5).
- Port the degree-5 polynomial coefficients, 20-iteration bisection, WCAG luminance and hex formatting (toString(16).padStart(2,'0')) verbatim.

theme-controller.ts:
- TERMINAL_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS=100. Late replies are applied through onLateReply. Merge with previous colors and skip the re-render when equal.
- Mode 2031 scheme notifications are enabled only for auto pairs or the system theme. The '<in-memory>' theme name is used for preview. rebindTui is called after a renderer swap.

Other:
- highlightCode/getMarkdownTheme map highlight.js scope classes to theme tokens (cli-highlight style); this depends on the utils/syntax-highlight port producing the same token classes.
- getLanguageFromPath extension map: port verbatim.
- getThemeExportColors converts okhsl to hex for CSS and numbers to hex via indexedColor (#5596).
- Test sharing: max-thinking.test.ts is shared with cli/args; syntax-highlight.test.ts only for its 'theme syntax highlighting' describe (rest belongs to utils).

units.title: Interactive support modules (viewport, TUI renderer handle, model search/refresh, external editor, session share, /bug flow) plus InteractiveMode module-level helpers and options
units.notes:
Module layout. Rust: modes::interactive::{chat_viewport, tui_renderer, model_search, model_catalog_refresh, external_editor, session_share, bug_report} and interactive_mode::helpers. Go: model_search, model_catalog_refresh and external_editor must live below components (e.g. package interactive/support), because components/model-selector, scoped-models-selector and extension-editor import them. chat_viewport, tui_renderer, session_share and bug_report live in package interactive.

chat-viewport:
- ScrollView: follow 'end', primary, overscroll 'chain', scrollbar default 'auto'.
- VStack dock in order: pendingMessages, status, widgetsAbove?, editor (minSize 3), widgetsBelow?, footer.
- Also used by experimental/client-tui.

tui-renderer:
- createInteractiveTui picks TuiAltScreen for fullscreen (search styles from theme, scrollToEndIndicator ' ↓ Jump to latest message · <key> ', openUrl, copySelection with confirmation, wheelScrollLines 'auto') or TuiMainScreen.
- createInteractiveTuiReference is a JS Proxy that re-resolves the renderer at each call (#7731). Natively, use a handle type (Rust Rc<RefCell<Renderer>> or enum Renderer{Main,Alt} behind an indirection; Go a struct holding a pointer swapped on switchTuiMode) whose methods always dispatch to the current renderer. The first #7731 case monkeypatches tui.render, which has no native equivalent; port only the 'captured method routes to replacement' semantics.

model-search:
- getModelSearchText = `${id} ${provider} ${provider}/${id} ${provider} ${id}${name}`; getModelSelectorSearchText omits the leading id. Copy the exact concatenation, including the missing space before the name.

model-catalog-refresh:
- A WeakMap keyed by runtime holds one shared refresh with a waiter count; the shared AbortController aborts when the last waiter leaves.
- Natively: a map keyed by Arc pointer/ID (Rust Weak, Go pointer key with cleanup) plus CancellationToken/context. raceWithAbortSignal becomes tokio::select!/Go select on ctx.Done().

external-editor:
- mkdtemp(os.tmpdir()/'pi-editor-'), write prompt.md, command.split(' ') (naive split, keep it), spawn with stdio inherit (shell:true on win32).
- Async spawn, not spawnSync, because of a Windows console input race.
- Print exactly 'Launching external editor: <cmd>\nPi will resume when the editor exits.\n'.
- Exit 0: stripBom, then remove one trailing '\n'. Non-zero or spawn error: {status:'failed'}. Always rm -rf the temp dir.
- Replace fixtures/fake-external-editor.mjs with a native fake: a test helper binary or sh/cmd script.

session-share:
- createShareTrailingEntries emits {type:'custom', customType:'pi.share', id: randomUUID().slice(0,8), parentId, timestamp ISO, data:{systemPrompt, tools:[{name,description,parameters}]}}. Keep JSON key order for byte-compatible JSONL.
- Radius first: POST `${DEFAULT_RADIUS_GATEWAY}/v1/artifacts?visibility=organization&title=Pi session` (URL-encode the title the same way), Bearer auth, Content-Type application/x-ndjson, Content-Length. Response uses artifact.canonical_url or error.
- Fallback: gh auth status (spawnSync), exportToHtml, then gh gist create --public=false; parse the gist id from the URL. getShareViewerUrl(gistId).
- BorderedLoader with cancel (abort kills the child).
- Tests mock node:child_process; inject a CommandRunner trait/interface instead.

bug-report (/bug flow):
- ExtensionEditor with disclaimer, then transcript choice, summary choice (session.summarizeForBugReport), then Upload/Zip/Cancel.
- Upload is blocked under PI_OFFLINE. It uses Radius auth with minOAuthValidityMs 5 min; on failure it offers a zip fallback written to cwd/bugReportArchiveFileName(id).
- On success, recordInSession appends BUG_REPORT_CUSTOM_ENTRY_TYPE and clears the crash log.

interactive-mode.ts#L1-L432 (port into interactive_mode/helpers.rs / helpers.go):
- Expandable/ExpandableText; WorkingStatusEditor duck-typing becomes a trait/interface.
- DEAD_TERMINAL_ERROR_CODES EIO/EPIPE/ENOTCONN.
- formatCrashExtensionHint and formatResumeCommand, with quoteIfNeeded regex /[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-./~:@]/ and single-quote escaping.
- ANTHROPIC_SUBSCRIPTION_AUTH_WARNING; isAnthropicSubscriptionAuthKey (sk-ant-oat prefix).
- llamaCppPostLoginGuidance, RADIUS_LOGIN_INTRO, AUTH_TYPE_ORDER, createFuzzyAutocompleteItems.
- InteractiveModeOptions struct.

assets/clankolas.png (640x537) is used by components/earendil-announcement via config.getBundledInteractiveAssetPath. Embed it or ship it at the same relative asset path.

Test sharing: bug-report.test.ts here covers only the 'bug report prompt' part; the redaction cases belong to core/bug-report. interactive-tui.test.ts also exercises handleRightClickPaste (events-input unit) and vi.mock's clipboard; inject a Clipboard seam.

units.title: InteractiveMode struct, constructor, autocomplete, TUI mount/switch, init() and run() startup flow
units.notes:
Rust: interactive_mode/mod.rs (struct + new) and core.rs. Go: interactive_mode.go and core.go.

Struct design:
- All six interactive-mode units are impl blocks / methods on ONE struct. Group fields into sub-structs (ui handle, containers, editor state, queues, extension-UI state, selector state, lifecycle flags) to limit borrow conflicts.
- Prefer single-threaded UI ownership: Rust Rc<RefCell<..>> on a LocalSet, or an mpsc command loop; Go confines all UI mutation to one goroutine and sends events over channels.
- Expose narrow traits/interfaces (SessionPort, RuntimeHost, UiPort, SettingsPort, ProcessControl, CommandRunner, Clipboard, Clock). Tests then build a real InteractiveMode with fakes instead of TS prototype.call(fakeThis).

Constructor:
- setCapabilityOverrides from settings; runtimeHost hooks (rebind and render callbacks).
- Renderer chosen by settings tuiMode; KeybindingsManager; CustomEditor with embedWorkingStatus.
- FooterDataProvider (git branch watcher); setRegisteredThemes; InteractiveThemeController.

Autocomplete:
- getAutocompleteSourceTag and prefixAutocompleteDescription.
- getBuiltInCommandConflictDiagnostics: extension commands shadowing built-ins.
- createBaseAutocompleteProvider: /model provider/id fuzzy items, /thinking levels, /login providers, prompt templates, extension and skill commands.
- setupAutocompleteProvider wraps base providers with extension AutocompleteProviderFactory in registration order and merges triggerCharacters. Natively each wrapper is a trait object receiving the inner provider.

TUI lifecycle:
- mountInteractiveTui, stopInteractiveTui, switchTuiMode. Use isViewportTUI / instanceof TuiAltScreen checks as an enum match.
- Rebind the ui handle and the theme controller after a switch.

init() order matters (tests assert it):
1. Signal handlers.
2. Changelog and scope line.
3. Viewport.
4. Buffered startup input forwarded via handleStartupSubmit.
5. ui.start.
6. Theme apply and wait for terminal colors (100ms timeout).
7. Header ExpandableText with logo.
8. ensureTool('fd'/'rg'), which may download.
9. Key handlers and rebind.
10. onThemeChange re-render; branch watcher.
11. loadAllHighlightLanguages, then re-render. In TS this is a dynamic import; natively the languages are linked statically, so this is a no-op or immediate.

run():
- refreshModelCatalogs bounded 15s.
- Version check and package updates (package-manager; npm/git sources are out of scope for TS extensions but still listed). Restore the win32 console title after the package check.
- checkTmuxKeyboardSetup only when TMUX is set: `tmux show -gv extended-keys` with a 2s timeout.
- Startup diagnostics; invalid settings warning (#7829); migrated providers; models.json errors; crash notice (core/crash-log); Anthropic subscription warning; initial messages; main loop over getUserInput().

reportInstallTelemetry:
- fetch `https://pi.dev/api/report-install?version=<v>` with the pi user agent and AbortSignal.timeout(5000).
- Honor the telemetry setting and PI_OFFLINE; go through http-dispatcher proxy config.

Other:
- updateTerminalTitle (OSC title): copy the exact format.
- getMarkdownThemeWithSettings adds codeBlockIndent.

units.title: InteractiveMode resource listing, session binding/crash handling, status indicators, extension widgets/header/footer, ExtensionUIContext and extension dialogs
units.notes:
Rust: interactive_mode/{resources.rs, session_binding.rs, extension_ui.rs}. Go: resources.go, session_binding.go, extension_ui.go.

showLoadedResources:
- Groups context files, skills, prompts, extensions and themes by scope (user/project/package) with compact labels and getShortPath (home becomes ~).
- Uses npm and git source regexes and strips /\/index\.(ts|js)$/.
- formatDiagnostics output must match interactive-mode-status.test.ts byte for byte after stripAnsi.
- User TS extensions are not loaded natively; the extension list shows only native built-ins (mcp, codemode, llama, tool-search). Unsupported-TS-extension diagnostics come from the resource-loader area.
- shouldShowStartupHeader / shouldShowStartupDetails follow quiet-startup settings.

Session binding:
- bindCurrentSessionExtensions passes the UI context, command context and shortcuts to the runner.
- rebindCurrentSession must guard against stale overlapping rebinds with a generation counter (startup-session-rebind test).
- #5943 ordering: render session state and loaded resources, then subscribe, then emit session_start. On reload, run the render hook and refresh hideThinkingBlock before handlers can notify; keep the reload blocker focused until reload completes.
- applyRuntimeSettings / applyFullscreenScrollbarSetting.

Crash handling:
- handleFatalRuntimeError, recordCrash (crash log), getCrashExtensionHint, crashReportInstructions.
- maybeSuggestBugReport is a one-time hint.

Status indicators:
- StatusIndicator spinners hold timers; dispose them deterministically.
- Extension working indicators (custom frames/interval), setWorkingVisible, hidden thinking label.
- The editor-embedded working status uses the WorkingStatusEditor capability (trait with an optional method).

Widgets, header and footer:
- setExtensionWidget accepts string[] (truncated to MAX_WIDGET_LINES=10) or a factory (tui, theme) -> Component, placed above or below the editor.
- setExtensionFooter / setExtensionHeader factories; resetExtensionUI on rebind.
- Terminal input listeners return consume/replace data.

createExtensionUIContext:
- A large object of closures in TS. Natively it is a struct implementing the ExtensionUiContext trait/interface from core/extensions/types, holding a weak handle back to InteractiveMode.
- Factories are Rust Box<dyn Fn> / Go func values supplied only by native built-in extensions.

Dialogs:
- showExtensionSelector/Confirm/Input/Editor accept {signal, timeout}. Resolve via oneshot channel; return undefined/None on abort or timeout and clean up the countdown timer.
- promptForMissingSessionCwd.
- setCustomEditorComponent copies actionHandlers, onSubmit, onChange and similar from the default editor via duck typing across module copies (jiti). Natively use a trait with default methods plus explicit handler transfer.
- showExtensionCustom creates an overlay with OverlayOptions and a done callback.
- showExtensionNotify levels: info/warning/error.

Tests:
- interactive-mode-status.test.ts (1283 lines) also exercises showStatus and showManagedToolStatus (events-input unit) and setupAutocompleteProvider / createBaseAutocompleteProvider (core unit). Port it against the full struct with fakes.

units.title: InteractiveMode key handlers, paste, submit dispatch, agent event handling, transcript rendering, shutdown/signals/suspend, queue management
units.notes:
Rust: interactive_mode/{input.rs, events.rs, transcript.rs, lifecycle.rs, queues.rs}. Go: same file split.

Key handlers:
- Bind through KeybindingsManager action ids; never hardcode keys.
- Double-escape within 500ms runs settings.doubleEscapeAction (tree, fork or none).
- Ctrl+C twice within 500ms exits; Ctrl+D on an empty editor exits.
- Use an injectable Clock for these windows in tests.

Paste:
- handleRightClickPaste.
- handleClipboardPaste:
  - An image goes to os.tmpdir()/pi-clipboard-<randomUUID>.<ext>, inserted as a path.
  - File-path lists are rejected if they contain control characters (/\p{Cc}/u: Rust regex \p{Cc} or char::is_control; Go unicode.IsControl).
  - Native clipboard errors are surfaced as warnings (clipboard-image-native-errors).

Submit dispatch (setupEditorSubmitHandler):
- Exact slash-command names, including extension and skill commands.
- '!cmd' runs user bash in context; '!!cmd' runs it excluded from context.
- While compacting, queue the message (CompactionQueuedMessage); while streaming, steer.
- handleStartupSubmit replays input typed before init.

handleEvent:
- Exhaustive match over AgentSessionEvent: agent_start/end, message_start/update/end, tool_execution_start/update/end, auto_compaction_*, auto_retry_*, compaction_cost, cache_warming_usage, queue_update, thinking level/model changes, and so on.
- Pending tool components stay registered by toolCallId across a thinking-visibility rebuild (#4167, #8611 keep partial bash output).

Transcript rendering:
- addMessageToChat and renderSessionEntries (CompactionCostNotice placed after its summary).
- countDroppedThinkingBlocks / maybeShowThinkingDropNotice.
- Cache miss notice threshold: 20k tokens or $0.1.
- Cost strings use JS toFixed(2), which rounds exact ties half-up: 0.125 gives '0.13' (test expects '~$0.13'). Rust format!("{:.2}") and Go strconv give '0.12'. Implement a JS-compatible toFixed helper.
- showStatus coalesces consecutive status lines; showManagedToolStatus.
- rebuildChatFromMessages; renderProjectTrustWarningIfNeeded; getUserInput resolves a pending promise (oneshot channel).

Shutdown:
- Signal path (SIGTERM, plus SIGHUP on non-win32; listeners prepended): dispose extensions (session_shutdown), disable auto-sync, drainInput(1000ms), ui.stop, exit 0. Handlers stay registered until cleanup finishes (#5724). No resume hint.
- Interactive path: disable auto-sync, drain, stop, dispose, print the resume hint (formatResumeCommand) for persisted sessions, exit 0.
- Re-entrant shutdown is a no-op (#5080).
- emergencyTerminalExit uses code 129 on EIO/EPIPE/ENOTCONN from stdout/stderr.
- The uncaughtException handler records a crash. Natively use a panic hook plus explicit error paths.

Ctrl+Z (non-win32):
- Ignore SIGINT; register a one-shot SIGCONT handler that restores (ui.start, requestRender(true)); ui.stop; kill(0, SIGTSTP); clean up if it throws.
- The setInterval(2**30) keepalive exists only to keep the JS event loop alive; it is not needed natively.
- win32 shows a status message instead.
- Use signal-hook/nix (Rust) or os/signal + syscall.Kill(0, SIGTSTP) (Go) behind a ProcessControl seam so tests can assert calls.

Queues and expansion:
- Steering and follow-up queues; dequeue restores to the editor; compaction queue flush; pending bash components flush after streaming.
- handleOpenExternalEditor: $VISUAL then $EDITOR; ui.stop before, ui.start + requestRender(true) after.
- Thinking/model cycling, tool output expansion and thinking block visibility rebuild the chat.

units.title: InteractiveMode selectors: settings, thinking, model/scoped models, user-message fork/clone, tree navigation, session resume, trust and Anthropic warning
units.notes:
Rust: interactive_mode/selectors.rs. Go: selectors.go.

showSelector:
- Generic: swaps the editor for the selector component, focuses it, and restores the editor on done. Only one active selector exists at a time; disposeActiveSelector releases timers and refresh tokens.

showSettingsSelector:
- About 40 change callbacks. Each persists to SettingsManager (exact JSON keys) and applies live: theme preview/commit via InteractiveThemeController, tuiMode switch (switchTuiMode), scrollbar, image capability overrides, hideThinkingBlock rebuild, quiet startup, double-escape action, transport, and so on.
- Port this as a settings-change enum dispatched to apply functions, not 40 closures, where convenient.

Thinking and model commands:
- handleThinkingCommand / selectThinkingLevel include the 'max' level.
- handleModelCommand / findExactModelMatch: try the cached catalog first, then a bounded refresh (15s) only if there is no match (#7443).
- updateAvailableProviderCount.

showModelsSelector (scoped models):
- Renders cached models immediately and updates after the background refresh; cancels the refresh when the selector closes (#7153).
- Keeps enabled-but-unavailable patterns visible and removable without clearing a partial scope (#6949).

Other selectors:
- showUserMessageSelector (fork) and handleCloneCommand.
- showTreeSelector:
  - Summary choice loop via showExtensionSelector.
  - Abort of a running branch summary.
  - Exact busy message: 'Wait for the current compaction or tree navigation to finish before navigating the session tree.'
  - Restores queued messages after navigation.
- showSessionSelector / handleResumeSession: MissingSessionCwdError leads to promptForMissingSessionCwd.
- Anthropic subscription warning (maybeWarnAboutAnthropicSubscriptionAuth; sk-ant-oat keys), implicit trust handling, trust selector.

Tests:
- Tree-navigation and anthropic-warning tests use prototype.call(fakeThis). Restructure them against seams (SessionPort with isStreaming/isCompacting/navigateTree/abort fakes).

units.title: InteractiveMode login/logout/auth dialogs, Radius MCP offer, and slash-command handlers (reload, export, import, share, bug, session, hotkeys, debug, easter eggs, user bash, compact) plus stop()
units.notes:
Rust: interactive_mode/{auth.rs, commands.rs}. Go: auth.go, commands.go.

Auth:
- Provider options:
  - getLoginProviderOptions / getLogoutProviderOptions are sorted by AUTH_TYPE_ORDER (oauth-selector.test.ts first case; the remaining cases belong to the components area).
  - handleLoginCommand with an optional provider argument; showLoginAuthTypeSelector; showLoginProviderSelector.
  - showOAuthSelector handles logout.
- Auth flows are driven by AuthEvent/AuthPrompt streams from pi-ai auth. showAuthPrompt races the abort signal (tokio::select! / Go select on ctx).
  - showAmbientAuthDialog: amazon-bedrock details.
  - showApiKeyLoginDialog.
  - showAuthSelect and notifyAuthDialog.
- completeProviderAuthentication:
  - Applies defaultModelPerProvider, llama.cpp guidance and the Radius flow.
  - Must not wait for an older stalled catalog refresh. Its own refresh is bounded to 15s and deferred after login completes (#7027/#7113). It reports an empty catalog only after refresh and preserves a model selected during refresh.
- offerRadiusMcpServer edits mcp.json (extensions/mcp/config) with RADIUS_MCP_URL. Keep the JSON formatting (2-space indent, trailing newline) byte-compatible.

Commands:
- handleReloadCommand: reload resources, rebind, keep the blocker focused.
- handleExportCommand: html or jsonl chosen by extension. getPathCommandArgument handles quoted paths.
- handleImportCommand.
- handleShareCommand and handleBugCommand delegate to session-share.ts and bug-report.ts.
- handleCopyCommand (last assistant text to the clipboard) and handleNameCommand.
- handleSessionCommand uses Date.toLocaleString and Number.toLocaleString. Pick a deterministic en-US format natively and document it; toFixed for costs (JS half-up, see events unit).
- handleChangelogCommand.
- handleHotkeysCommand: markdown table built from KeybindingsManager display strings.
- handleClearCommand.
- handleDebugCommand writes to getDebugLogPath, with render lines as JSON.stringify'd strings. Match JS escaping: serde_json and Go json escape <, >, & and U+2028 differently by default; disable HTML escaping in Go via an Encoder.
- Easter eggs:
  - handleArminSaysHi: playArmin3d only in fullscreen (TuiAltScreen), lazily loaded in TS, statically linked natively.
  - handleDementedDelves.
  - handleDaxnuts and checkDaxnutsEasterEgg (opencode provider + kimi-k2.5).
- handleBashCommand: emitUserBash extension hook fails closed when a handler errors (#9068).
- handleCompactCommand.
- stop(): stop the TUI if initialized, then unregister signal handlers.

Test notes:
- #9068 also contains an 'RPC user_bash failure handling' describe; that part belongs to the rpc-mode area.
- 7027 drives completeProviderAuthentication through prototype access. Port it with the suite harness plus a faux ModelRuntime refresh that stalls.
